# Analysis specification recorded before the FA*IR runs

Use 5%, 10%, and 15% of each course/school, rounded down with a minimum of one. Primary contrast is the existing 10% budget. Hold the original tie permutation and cross-course risk models fixed. Compare unrestricted, original largest-remainder quotas and one-sided FA*IR. Protect recorded group 0 (female) throughout, using its within-pool population share p and nominal alpha 0.10. Use fairsearchcore 1.0.4 adjusted tables. Independently check the binomial lower quantiles at the returned adjustment, each prefix, the greedy choice and exact null crossing probability. Record small-k exceptions and realized error probabilities.

Transfer the allocation procedure to the UCI 320 mathematics file only, holding out each school in turn. Predict final grade G3 below 10/20 from G1, G2 and past failures using the same model classes and settings. Use the published sex field F as the protected group. Report captured counts and recall for each group, female share selected, seats replaced and prefix violations on unrestricted lists. All labels retrospective. This specification follows the earlier 10% two-policy analysis and is not an external preregistration.
